governance

R package for creating a nonprofit governance index score from IRS Form 990 efile data. It normalizes the governance and management fields of the 990 into a binary feature matrix, then scores them against a factor model derived empirically from the full filing population for benchmarking.

Installation 

devtools::install_github( 'nonprofit-open-data-collective/governance' )

Usage

The workflow is two steps: normalize raw 990 fields into features with get_features(), then score them with get_scores().

Step 1: Get input data

get_features() expects raw 990 efile fields from Part IV, Part VI, Part XII, and Schedule M. See the Download Data vignette for the field list and input contract. Retrieval of the efile tables is handled by the companion panel990 package (in development); until then you can pull them from the NCCS efile v2.1 archive.

The package ships a ready-to-use example (a 5,000-organization sample of raw 2022 fields):

data("dat_example", package = "governance")

set.seed(57)
dat_example <- dat_example[sample(seq_len(nrow(dat_example)), 200), ]

Step 2: Build the feature matrix 

features_example <- get_features(dat_example)

Step 3: Calculate the scores 

scores_example <- get_scores(features_example)

get_scores() appends six factor scores and a total.score. See the Governance Workflow vignette for a fuller walk-through and the Making Governance Scores vignette for the methodology.
